name: DECLARATION
adoption_rule: PANEL-THINNING TEST (DESIGN §4 panel-density robustness; D17(d)), GBDT_AB_17 on feature set A+B (tb_asym_* excluded), hyper-parameters fixed, no re-tuning, seeds config/seeds.yaml, same folds. Thinned-panel Tier B tables tierB_dmin<c>.parquet, c in {0.03, 0.12, 0.35}, recomputed from the cached panel hits (species with d_s < c removed). Statistic T_pf (per-fold paired dAP vs B1, mean over species) with per-species dAP vs B1. Conditions per c: N->N (incumbent), N->T<c> (train natural, evaluate thinned), T<c>->T<c> (train and evaluate thinned), A<c>->N and A<c>->T<c> (masking augmentation: train on natural plus c-masked copies of each training pair; all copies of a pair in the pair's fold; pair weights (species-balanced, computed on pairs) spread over the pair's unique copies so each pair sums to its pair weight; identical copies deduplicated; min_samples_leaf counted in pairs (x rows/pairs); no early stopping; evaluation on one row per pair). ADOPTION RULE for masking augmentation, decided at c=0.35: adopt iff (1) T_pf(N->N) - T_pf(N->T0.35) > 0 with the 95% percentile paired-bootstrap CI of the drop excluding 0, AND (2) T_pf(A0.35->T0.35) - T_pf(N->T0.35) >= 0.5 x the drop (recovers at least half), AND (3) T_pf(N->N) - T_pf(A0.35->N) <= 0.01 (natural-panel T_pf not lowered by more than 0.01). Point estimates for (2) and (3). c = 0.03 and 0.12 are reported, not decisive.
notes: pre-declared before any score of this run was computed; masking augmentation adopted only if the declared rule (decided at c=0.35) holds

name: DECLARATION
adoption_rule: ROBUSTNESS TEST (DESIGN §6.5 'Robustness test'; reporting level 3 = exploratory; NO adoption decision depends on it). Model fixed: GBDT_AB_17 on feature set A+B (tb_asym_* excluded), hyper-parameters fixed, no re-tuning, seeds config/seeds.yaml, same dev folds as the incumbent. Degraded proteomes (scripts/robustness/degrade_proteome.py, seed 11 = seeds[0]): fragments (20% of proteins truncated to a random 50-80% of their length at a random N- or C-terminus), split (5% of genes split at a random internal point; longer piece keeps the gene ID, shorter gets a new ID), fused (2% of genes get another random non-labelled gene's sequence appended; donor removed), missing (15% of genes removed), haplotig (5% of genes get an extra near-identical copy, 1% random substitutions, new ID), combined (all of them: missing -> fused -> split -> fragments -> haplotig). Yeast: all six kinds (+ an identity control = natural proteome through the same route); human: combined only. Tier A+B features of each degraded proteome from `slparalog predict --features-only --tier-b` (existing panel databases; <=8 threads; runtime recorded). Evaluation (thinning N->T design): train on the NATURAL features of the training folds, evaluate the held-out fold on the DEGRADED features of the same labelled pairs; pairs map to degraded gene IDs through the mapping table; pairs that lose a gene or are no longer called are scored at the minimum score (one tie block), B1 (ident_global) identically; the population (natural labelled & called dev pairs) is unchanged. Reported per species x kind: per-fold mean AP of the model and of B1, natural and degraded, dAP vs B1 per species (T_pf for the combined kind, where both species exist), and the natural-to-degraded drops (model, B1, model-minus-B1) with 95% stratified group-bootstrap percentile CIs (same resamples, paired); pooled-OOF APs, prevalence and counts, and the number of lost pairs. No decision rule: no thresholds, nothing is adopted or rejected on this result.
